derek.holt: Quick internal announcement — launching a small H400-Balanced Dedicated preview in Frankfurt (eu-central-3) starting now. Target: customers who need consistent mid/high throughput with lower power draw. :sparkles:

anya.kovalenko: Nice. Any policy changes for this preview compared to other previews?

derek.holt: Yes — two notable differences: 1) a "burst-cap" policy limits non-reserved burst to 25% of pool capacity during peak hours to reduce noisy neighbor impact; 2) were offering a one-time reservation conversion path to GA: customers who reserve for the preview can convert to a GA reserved commitment within 5 days of preview end for a 10% committed-use credit. No formal SLA until GA.

ops-bot: [automated] pool-create: dedicated-h400bal-eu-central-3-01 created (10x H400-Balanced). Telemetry: enabled.

sre-oncall: Ops notes: autoscaling disabled for preview. Reservation windows protected from preemption; non-reserved workloads may be reclaimed to honor burst-cap rules. We're also scheduling a short maintenance window on day 3 for a firmware patch (ETA 20m).

finance-bot: [automated] billing-note: preview uses standard dedicated SKU rates. Conversion-to-GA credit (10%) applied as account credit upon confirmed GA commit. Cancellation policy: cancellations <24h before reservation start will incur an internal reallocation charge.

anya.kovalenko: Runbook snippet for teams and AMs:
```
# reserve preview capacity
rcli reserve --region eu-central-3 --gpu H400-Balanced --count 2 --days 7
# view pool info
rcli pool info --name dedicated-h400bal-eu-central-3-01
# convert preview reservation to GA commit (after preview end)
rcli reservation convert --id <reservation-id> --to-ga --note "convert-for-10pct-credit"
# cancel (24h fee applies)
rcli reserve cancel --id <reservation-id>
```

sre-oncall: Thermal/telemetry alert rule created: h400bal-eu-c3-therm (warn 80%, critical 94%). Also added burst-cap metric: h400bal-eu-c3-burst-util (warn 60% of cap).

sales-emea: Heads-up for account teams: mark outbound offers as "preview: limited capacity; conversion option to GA available". Don't promise GA SLAs. Use the conversion path wording when discussing long-term commitments.

derek.holt: Note on expected performance: due to smaller pool size, tell customers "typical steady throughput ~70-80% of our large eu-west pools; latency p50/p95 will be posted after 48h of telemetry." Billing rate identical; effective unit costs may be higher until scale improvements.

ops-bot: [automated] follow-up scheduled: telemetry snapshot in 48h. Please tag tickets with `dedicated-h400bal-eu-c3` for support.

anya.kovalenko: We'll post a short FAQ and the conversion flow in Confluence and ping AMs. Link (internal): https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated/eu-central-3-h400-preview — will update after 48h snapshot.

derek.holt: Thanks all. We'll revisit burst-cap and GA timeline after the 72h review. :rocket:
